description: This file contains JUnit 5 test cases for the 'ObsBehavior' functionality within the OpenMRS core project. It specifically tests the behavior of Obs entities when loaded from the database, their 'dirty' states, and the process of voiding and updating observations within medical encounters.

classes.name: ObsBehaviorTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class that performs end-to-end testing of Observation (Obs) behavior in the OpenMRS system, especially focusing on loading, dirty state, voiding, and updating Obs records within encounters.

methods.name: shouldHaveAnObsLoadedFromTheDatabaseAsNotDirty
methods.description: Tests that an Obs loaded from the database is marked as not dirty.

methods.name: shouldHaveAllObsLoadedWithAnEncounterFromTheDatabaseNotMarkedAsDirty
methods.description: Verifies that all Obs associated with a loaded Encounter are not marked as dirty.

methods.name: shouldVoidAndReplaceOnlyEditedUnvoidedObsWhenTheyAreFlushedToTheDatabase
methods.description: Tests logic for voiding and replacing only the edited and unvoided Obs when the encounter is saved, ensuring proper voiding and creation of new Obs records.
